subtasks.description: Declare RAM storage as a 32-bit wide array of depth FIFO_TX_MEM_DEPTH, write pointer adr_i (width FIFO_RX_MEM_ADR_SIZE) in wclk domain, read pointer adr_o (same width) in rclk domain, and any internal synchronizer registers required for cross-clock pointer transfer (e.g., gray-encoded pointer registers and multi-flop synchronizer flip-flops).
constraints: Port/interface signals must match the specifications in S004 exactly (widths, directions).
Declare RAM using Verilog memory array (e.g., reg [31:0] ram [0:FIFO_TX_MEM_DEPTH-1]); do not use generate blocks.

subtasks.description: On the rising edge of wclk, if rst is high, reset adr_i to 0. Otherwise, if wr is high and full is low, write the input data d into ram at address adr_i, then increment adr_i with wrap-around: if adr_i equals FIFO_TX_MEM_DEPTH-1, next adr_i = 0; else adr_i = adr_i + 1.
constraints: Use simple sequential always block; no generate.
Wrap-around must depend on the parameter FIFO_TX_MEM_DEPTH.

subtasks.description: On the rising edge of rclk, if rst is high, reset adr_o to 0. Otherwise, if rd is high and empty is low, increment adr_o with wrap-around: if adr_o equals FIFO_TX_MEM_DEPTH-1, next adr_o = 0; else adr_o = adr_o + 1.
constraints: Use simple sequential always block; no generate.

subtasks.description: Synchronize adr_i to the rclk domain and adr_o to the wclk domain using a safe cross-clock method such as gray encoding followed by two-stage synchronizer flip-flops. In the wclk domain, generate the full flag by comparing the synchronized read pointer with the current write pointer (accounting for gray code comparison). In the rclk domain, generate the empty flag by comparing the synchronized write pointer with the current read pointer. Compute occupancy mem_empt as the valid difference between synchronized write and read pointers (adr_i minus adr_o with wrap handling), output as a 6-bit value.
constraints: Gray encoding must correctly handle pointer wrap; use conventional binary-to-gray conversion for each pointer.
Synchronizer should be a pair of flip-flops in the target clock domain; do not use async handshake or fifo IP.
mem_empt width must be exactly 6 bits as per interface spec S004.

subtasks.description: Drive output q from the RAM at address adr_o. The data output may be combinational (assign q = ram[adr_o]) or registered on the rclk edge (e.g., if a register is used to stabilize timing). If registered, the registered version must still read from ram using adr_o.
constraints: If combinational, ensure q is not glitching due to asynchronous RAM read; if registered, use a simple always block on rclk.
